definition.derivation: generatedAt minus the newest Git committer timestamp among lines in the exact task block
definition.qualification: only emitted when source file is clean, its full SHA-256 matches the workboard manifest, and its block SHA-256 matches the controller
limitations: Git history age is a task-block change-age signal, not proof of task readiness, truth, or completion.
Uncommitted or stale source rows are absent, never filled from filesystem timestamps.
